name: NorthstarSupportChatbot
description: This flow handles customer inquiries regarding order status, return requests, stock availability, and escalates out-of-scope queries to human support.

customer_message.description: The incoming message from the customer.

order_id.description: The ID of the customer's order, if provided.

product_name.description: The name of the product inquiring about stock, if provided.

category.description: The classified category of the customer message.

final_reply.description: The final composed reply for the customer.

methods.name: classify_question
methods.description: Classifies customer questions into relevant categories.

methods.name: route_by_category
methods.description: Routes to the appropriate handler based on the classified message category.

methods.name: check_order_id_present
methods.description: Checks if the order ID is present for order status inquiries.

methods.name: lookup_order_status
methods.description: Fetches the order status based on the provided order ID.

methods.name: save_order_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed order status reply in the final reply state.

methods.name: request_order_id
methods.description: Requests the customer to provide their order ID.

methods.name: save_order_id_missing_reply
methods.description: Saves a prompt requesting the customer to provide their order ID.

methods.name: lookup_return_policy
methods.description: Retrieves the return policy information for the customer.

methods.name: save_return_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed return policy reply in the final reply state.

methods.name: check_stock_availability
methods.description: Checks stock availability for the provided product name.

methods.name: save_stock_reply
methods.description: Saves the stock availability reply in the final reply state.

methods.name: flag_for_human_review
methods.description: Flags the inquiry for human review when out of scope.

methods.name: save_escalation_reply
methods.description: Saves an escalation message for the customer in the final reply state.
